artifact_limitation: The frozen v1 runner preserves raw_response only for accepted cases. Criteria requiring inspection of rejected content cannot be certified and are therefore marked false.
decision: Reject Qwen3 14B for model-driven synthesis under the frozen v1 contract. Do not enable persistence or batch synthesis. Prefer deterministic synthesis/gating, optionally using the LLM only to render a validated human-readable explanation.
